---
title: "Unit 05 · Ordinary differential equations and molecular dynamics"
toc: false
---

Unit 5 develops the numerical solution of ordinary differential equations, the step that turns Newton's second law into a trajectory of atoms in time. The bridging lecture [L22](L22/index.qmd) precedes this unit: it follows the pitch-drop experiment from the funnel to the atoms and links each level to a simulation method and its numerical core. [L23](L23/index.qmd) begins with the mathematics of ODEs.

- [L23 · Ordinary differential equations and initial-value problems](L23/index.qmd)
